# Objective

Apply the two verified seventh-round review findings as one fix batch,
closing the placement-independent-exclusion class completely and
reserving the rescue tag at validation.

# Verified findings (both reproduced before fixing)

1. The cross-contig rescue path bypassed the hard-clip and
   missing-quality gates (and, found while tracing, the read-group
   conflict gate): relocation and `ZR` tagging happened before any merge
   gate ran, then the merge rejected the pair — while the same-contig
   equivalents never entered rescue (`try_merge` applies those gates
   before its placement-level reasons). Same defect class as the round-6
   non-primary finding, fixed incompletely.
2. `--status-tag ZR` passed validation (ZR matches the generic two-char
   pattern) and aborted the run with exit 1 at classification time: the
   rescue marker `ZR:i:1` is an int, and `assign_status_tag` refuses
   non-string values.

# Changes as executed

- `src/pairloom/pipeline.py`: `_rescue_shape_blocked(r1, r2, others)`
  checks non-primary records, H/N CIGAR ops, missing qualities, and
  conflicting read groups; both rescue call sites pass it into
  `rescue_eligible` (the `has_non_primary` parameter became
  `shape_blocked`). Blocked templates keep their placements on every
  path and report `different_contig` on the cross-contig path.
- `src/pairloom/config.py`: `RESCUE_TAG`/`RESCUE_VALUE` now live here
  (classify imports config, never the reverse, so validation can
  reference the constants without a cycle); `--status-tag ZR` raises a
  `ConfigurationError` naming the reservation (startup exit 2).
  `src/pairloom/classify.py` imports the constants from config.
- Tests (suite 176 → 182): cross-contig hard-clip, missing-qualities,
  and RG-conflict templates never relocate; same-contig parity pinned;
  config-level rejection and CLI exit-2 coverage.
- README (rescue exclusions, `ZR` reservation, test count) and AGENTS.md
  invariant 10 updated.

# Verification

- `pixi run test`: 182 passed; `pixi run lint` / `pixi run format`:
  clean.
- Both reproductions re-run at the original sites: hard-clipped and
  quality-less cross-contig pairs keep `seq2:0`/`seq1:2` without `ZR`
  (reason `different_contig`); `--status-tag ZR` exits 2 before reading
  the input; the standard rescue example still merges with the default
  tag.
- Benchmarks: both fixes touch cold paths (an eligibility predicate over
  already-loaded records and config validation), so the existing
  benchmark results stand unchanged; no re-run required.
